population.frame_rule: the account's civilian G3+ (generation_results_sept29.csv, convention a) over the population lane's self-identified third-plus (all person records): row 4 leaves US-born weights alone
population.split_rule: bounds_coverage_fiscal.py arm 5 (identity_loss_propagation population_arms.csv): G3-rate = min(added, (1 - p3) x corrected third-plus), later losses = the rest

fractional_ancestry.rule: a quarter per Mexico-born grandparent; hidden = children - self-identified per cell (arm3_grandparent_counts.csv); later losses take the same weight, an upper bound

G3plus.bound_rule: the identified third generation at a quarter per Mexico-born grandparent; G4+ (grandparents seen, none born in Mexico) at nothing (bound_low) or its measured high bound (bound_high); members without grandparent detail at the seen members' mix
G3plus.convention_rule: the identified third-generation children's quarter-per-grandparent mix (population lane convention), applied to every identified third-plus member
G3plus.seen_rule: members with both biological parents at home (grandparents seen): low counts only Mexico-born grandparents (the strict quarter rule), high gives every US-born grandparent of a Mexican-origin parent full Mexican-immigrant ancestry

added.rule: the hidden third generation's quarter-per-grandparent mix (population.json); later losses take it too

meta.note: low / high are the band's ends, specifications 48 (shared allocation) / 11 (personal); every arm's ends are v4's (gate)

c3_line.rule: v5 = intercept_bn + slope_bn x C3 at the arm's responses and ends (C3 does not move s)

route.rule: post_engine_bn: v4 + m_G G3+ members + m_W whites per line at v4's responses; gap_bn = this lane's band - post_engine_bn

replacement.rule: [FRAMING-SENSITIVE] the band net of r x W x added persons (a native parent's replacement child); W the C3 blend's third-plus non-Hispanic white per person at the arm's responses; band = min / max over the 64 specifications

fractional.rule: [FRAMING-SENSITIVE] the people-conserving lineage count (lineage_cost_2026_09_19 per_capita, TFR/2): each generation at its share of Mexican-immigrant ancestry, priced at that generation's cost at the arm's responses; band = min / max over the 64 specifications; derived/fractional_lineage.csv
